issue_title: [Security] _ensure_parent_directory() uses exists() and is_dir() which follow symlinks, all

test_coverage.notes: 5 comprehensive regression tests covering symlink-to-file, symlink-to-directory, normal directories, new directory creation, and symlink-in-parent-path scenarios

code_quality.notes: Clean implementation using is_symlink() to detect symlinks without following them. Clear error messages and documentation.

minimal_change.notes: Minimal change - added 12 lines of code to detect symlinks before the existing file-as-directory check

security_fix.notes: Properly addresses the TOCTOU race condition by using is_symlink() which checks without following symlinks

backward_compatibility.notes: All existing tests pass. Only behavior change is rejecting symlinks which is a security improvement.

summary: Fix for security issue #5693: _ensure_parent_directory() now uses is_symlink() to detect symlinks in the parent path without following them. This prevents TOCTOU race conditions and symlink attacks where an attacker could redirect file writes to unintended locations.
